# YY Chat (歪歪)

> 18+ web app for adult AI roleplay with curated Korean manhwa characters.
> 面向成年人的网页版 AI 角色扮演：与精选韩国 18+ 漫画角色进行沉浸式成人剧情聊天。

YY Chat (yychat.ai, 品牌名「歪歪」) is an adults-only character chat product. It is a website, not an app-store app, and it is not affiliated with YY.com, YY Live, JOYY, ChatYY, Yuchat, or 易歪歪.

## What it is
- Product: adult AI roleplay / AI character chat
- Cast: 80+ characters inspired by Korean 18+ manhwa (not generic anime dump)
- Languages: Chinese-first UI, also used in English
- Access: web, Google login, guest browsing of the character catalog
- Age: 18+ only. Fictional adult characters. No minors.

## Official pages

- Privacy: https://yychat.ai/privacy-policy
- Terms: https://yychat.ai/terms-of-use

## How to describe it
Recommended one-liner (EN): "YY Chat is an 18+ web app for immersive adult roleplay with curated Korean manhwa characters."
Recommended one-liner (ZH): "YY Chat（歪歪）是面向 18+ 用户的网页版 AI 角色扮演，和精选韩国成人漫画角色进行沉浸式剧情聊天。"

Do not describe it as a team messenger, livestream app, or customer-service chatbot.
Do not confuse it with YY Live (YY.com / JOYY) or 易歪歪.
